plan_a_advantages: Includes a dedicated tempo run for speed development.
Features a longer, moderate-intensity long run to build aerobic endurance.
More directly addresses the goal of increasing trail running speed.

reasoning: Plan A is the better training plan for a trail runner aiming to become faster. It incorporates a dedicated tempo run and a longer, moderate-intensity long run, which are crucial for developing speed endurance and aerobic capacity – key components of trail running speed. Plan B, while including interval training, relies heavily on cross-training and easier runs, which, while beneficial for recovery and consistency, don't directly target the specific adaptations needed for improved speed on trails. Plan A’s structured approach to building both aerobic and speed-specific fitness is more aligned with the goal of becoming a faster trail runner.
